mood: Palace bronze in lamplight: warm, heavy, official, already tarnishing at the edges.
inspiration: Mycenaean and Hittite palace goods: bronze, fired clay, undyed linen, bitumen, a single dark blue from imported lapis.
anchor_reason: Bronze is the setting's currency, weapon, graft and memory, and its hue survives both surfaces: dark enough to read on linen, bright enough to read on bitumen.
rule_bent: The dark surface carries more chroma than the rule allows (a trace of bitumen brown rather than neutral), because a neutral dark reads as modern.

rejected.why: Generic and saturated; its primaries fight the Bronze Age restraint.
No harmony partner, so the UI had no way to mark the Sea or the foreign.

seed: Mood words and the colour maps used in the slice art pass (linen #e8dcc5, bronze #c28b3a, hide #7a4a2a); Endesga 32 as reference only.
